correctness.rationale: Reconstructible exact proof: fourth spherical moments give unbiasedness, one-probe second moment, and E[q(u)q(v)] from Haar-frame conditional uniformity; Hilbert-Schmidt matrix inner products yield exact cross covariance, the sign frontier and the optimal risk ratios. All dimensions and boundaries are covered analytically. Actual package script checks the algebra and deterministic special cases; simulations are supplemental.

originality.rationale: Relevant published-record and prior-literature searches, together with substantive material from three pertinent primary studies, distinguish this exact calibrated single-frame quadratic estimator from two-direction, two-frame and incremental Hessian algorithms. All exact boundaries and maximal ratios are absent from the inspected statements. Since the moment identities are standard, those are not claimed as new; specialized older equivalence remains a disclosed risk.
residual_risks: Older works on spherical fourth moments or Stiefel random matrix estimators may contain an equivalent finite-k matrix-risk law in different notation.
No inaccessible publisher source is treated as a whole-document noncoverage certificate.
The distinction between algorithms is crucial; assertions about other unbiased Hessian estimators or nonlinear functions would not be justified.

value.rationale: A fixed-query full-Hessian estimator on quadratic black-box oracles is a natural model for zeroth-order optimization. The exact low-dimensional sharp criterion and dimension-four universal threshold resolve whether Haar-orthogonal frame probes can increase error; the 4/3 extremal inflation and PSD robustness are practically interpretable mathematical boundaries, rather than a parameter substitution or arbitrary slice.
